Definition: from G3068; a bath, i.e. (figuratively), baptism:--washing.
BiblicalUsage: loutrón means washing, and once is enough to see what it is doing. In Ephesians 5:26, "That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word"; and in Titus 3:5, "by the washing of regeneration".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the washing of water by the word is how Christ sanctifies His church — not by our works, but by His mercy and the renewing of the Holy Ghost.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
